low.title: Low
low.suggestionBody: Pause new tasks. Take a 20-minute nap or go for a walk; avoid high-effort plans today.

dipping.title: Dipping
dipping.suggestionTitle: Slow down and reduce the load
dipping.suggestionBody: Stick to lighter tasks and avoid back-to-back meetings. Take a 15-minute break within 90 minutes.

steady.title: Steady
steady.suggestionBody: Avoid another 90+ minute meeting block this afternoon. A 15–30 minute walk is your most reliable reset.

good.title: Good
good.suggestionBody: Use the next two hours for focused work, and leave space between meetings.

full.title: Full
full.suggestionBody: This is a prime deep-work window: block distractions and focus for 90 minutes.

events.voiceNote: “Just finished a meeting and my brain feels stuck”

insights.title: Your patterns
insights.subtitle: Find patterns in your own body data and life events, without replacing personal observations with generic health conclusions.
insights.footer: These are personal patterns, not medical conclusions, and are for reference only.
insights.drainerTitle: It isn't the afternoon. Continuous communication is the key.
insights.drainerBody: In the past 14 days, 5 of the 6 afternoons with a clear decline included more than 90 minutes of continuous meetings.
insights.boosterTitle: What truly restores you is getting outside.
insights.boosterBody: Your state improved after 7 of your last 8 walks lasting 15–30 minutes.
insights.newTitle: Socializing isn't the issue. Context is.
insights.newBody: Seeing friends more often improves your state; work socializing beyond 90 minutes is more likely to drain it.
